stat.jaymoskingdoms.presence.desc: How you carry yourself among people. It sways haggling, persuading, lying and threatening, how fast strangers warm to you, and how far your orders carry to companions.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.presence.now: +%s%% to talking people round, +%s%% faster warming, +%s%% farther orders
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.sparks.about: Pick what drives you, who you answer to and what trips you up. Acting on them earns a spark (one held at a time): it turns your next failed parry, lockpick or fear into a success, and can be given to a friend.
spark.ideal.honour.fx: Keeping your word and paying your dues.
spark.ideal.kindness.fx: Giving gifts and cutting people free.
spark.ideal.freedom.fx: Freeing captives and a night out.
spark.ideal.wealth.fx: Winning big and talking a better price.
spark.bond.friend.fx: Giving gifts and a night out.
spark.flaw.temper.fx: Earns a spark when a threat goes wrong.
spark.flaw.greed.fx: Earns a spark when cheating costs you.
spark.flaw.drink.fx: Earns a spark after a night out.
spark.flaw.pride.fx: Earns a spark when a lie goes wrong.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.title: Standing
standing.jaymoskingdoms.nostart: Your road left no lasting favour.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.circle.beggars: The poor of the street owe you
standing.jaymoskingdoms.circle.guards: Old comrades of the watch owe you
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.feed: They feed you when asked (Ask a Favour).
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.hide: They hide you from the watch for a while.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.passage: They carry you across the land to another realm.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.trust: The Underworld reads its chalk signs for you and sells you its papers.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.news: They pass on news of a place worth finding.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.shelter: They give you a bed and mend your wounds.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.salute: Guards who think no ill of you wave you through.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.boon.lore: They teach you what a foe fears.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.nopicks: You have not yet chosen an ideal, bond and flaw.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.spark.held: You hold a spark. The next failed parry, lockpick or fear is a success. You can give it to a friend near you.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.spark.none: You hold no spark. Live by your ideal and bond to earn one.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.life.rough: You live rough (%s). Guards stop you more, and priests pity you.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.life.well: You live well (%s). Courts open to you and guards hail you less.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.life.clothes.poo: Your clothes are shabby. A tailor can mend that.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.life.bath.poor: You are grimy. Soak in still water a while.
lifestyle.jaymoskingdoms.now.rough: You are living rough, and it shows.
lifestyle.jaymoskingdoms.now.well: You are living well, and it shows.
lifestyle.jaymoskingdoms.alms.0: Here, take this. No one should go hungry.
lifestyle.jaymoskingdoms.alms.1: The Lantern keeps the poor. Bread and a coin.
lifestyle.jaymoskingdoms.alms.2: You look worn through. Eat, and be well.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.feed.0: Eat. You are one of us.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.feed.1: There's bread for you, friend. Take it.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.feed.2: A kind word and a full pack, as it should be.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.hide.0: Get in the loft. I never saw you.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.hide.1: Under the straw, quick. They won't look there.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.hide.2: Keep your head down. I'll say nothing.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.shelter.0: There's a bed in the back. Rest, and let me see to that.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.shelter.1: Sleep here tonight. The Lantern shelters its own.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.shelter.2: Lie down. You will be mended by morning.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.passage.0: I know a boat leaving for %s. Come aboard.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.passage.1: A cart is going to %s. Climb up.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.passage.2: They're sailing to %s. You can ride along.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.lore.0: Careful of the %s. I've seen how it falls.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.lore.1: The %s? Learn this: it dreads what it cannot face.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.lore.2: I fought a %s once. Here is how it ended.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.lore.none: I've nothing more to teach you of the things you've fought.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.passage.none: No ship leaves from here to anywhere you could use.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.news.0: There's talk of a place worth finding, if you have the legs for it.
perk.jaymoskingdoms.news.2: Folk like us know where the old things lie.
rumour.jaymoskingdoms.line.1: I heard of a place %s. Old money, they say.
rumour.jaymoskingdoms.line.2: A sailor swore to me: there's a hoard %s.
rumour.jaymoskingdoms.none: I'd tell you something worth hearing, but I know nothing of the sort.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.ask: How will you put it to them?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.persuade.won.1: Hm. Put like that, I can't say no.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.persuade.won.2: You have a way with words. Very well.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.lie.won.0: Truly? Well then! Let me make it up to you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.lie.won.1: Is that so? I had no idea.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.lie.won.2: If that's how it is, I won't stand in your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.lie.lost.0: You're lying. I can see it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.lie.lost.2: Think I'm a fool? Get away from me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.threaten.won.0: No! Please, take it, take it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.threaten.won.2: All right, all right, just go!
Put that away. I'm not afraid of you.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.price.0: (He rubs his neck and won't meet your eye as he names the price.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.price.1: (The price comes a little too quickly, and a little too smoothly.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.price.2: (His smile stays put, but his eyes flick to the side.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.lead.0: (They point with certainty, but their gaze slides the other way.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.lead.1: (A beat too slow with the answer, and the hand wavers.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.lead.2: (They hide a smile as they point.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.alibi.0: (His hand goes to his belt as he answers.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.tell.alibi.2: (He glances at the gate, then away.)
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.honest.0: Quiet night. I was on the wall the whole time.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.honest.1: I held my post till dawn. Ask anyone.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.honest.2: Nothing to report, and I was where I should be.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.lie.0: At my post, naturally. All night. Never left it.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.lie.1: I was where I'm always found. You can trust that.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.lie.2: The gate, all night. Nowhere else.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.confess.0: I... was not at my post. A man paid me to look elsewhere. I can't lie to you now.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.confess.1: The truth? I took coin to turn my back. I couldn't tell you otherwise.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.confess.2: I was bought. There. I couldn't keep it in.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.bribe.refused.0: How dare you! I'll remember this insult.
liar.jaymoskingdoms.bribe.refused.1: Take your coin and be gone, or you'll be reported.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.alibi.bribe: Slip him %s emeralds' worth to look away
talk.jaymoskingdoms.night.ask: How big a night will it be?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.title: The Morning After
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.open.1.0: The last thing I remember clearly is %s setting down the first cup. After that the room starts to slide.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.open.1.1: It began innocently enough, a cup at %s's counter. I should have stopped at the first.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.open.2.0: The lamps burned low in the speakeasy. %s kept pouring, and I kept letting him.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.open.2.1: Down in the dark with %s, the coin ran like water. I remember laughing too loudly.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.nothing: Beyond that there's nothing. A blur, a headache, and a lighter purse.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.close: My head is splitting. Whatever I did, it is done.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.friend.0: Somewhere past midnight I was sharing a bench with %s, and we were friends for life. I think they meant it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.friend.1: I remember %s singing off-key beside me. We swore we would drink together again. They'd remember it too.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.rumour.0: A man in the corner leaned close and whispered of a hoard. I kept it: %s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.rumour.1: Someone slurred the tale of a lost place, and I held on to it: %s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.eye.0: I caught a fist with my face. There's a black eye to show for it, and no idea whose.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.eye.1: Somebody hit me, or I hit a door. Either way, my eye is swollen shut.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.debt.0: I lost to %s at the table, and signed for %s on credit. He wants it back in %s days.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.debt.1: There was a handshake with %s. I owe him %s now, and he said the word 'days': %s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.rival.0: I said something about %s's mother. I don't remember what. They remember every word.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.rival.1: I made an enemy of %s tonight. Chairs were involved.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.jail.0: The watch found me singing in the street. The cells of %s are cold, and I know them now.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.jail.1: I woke on straw behind iron. Drunk and disorderly, the guards of %s say.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.betrothed.0: I promised myself to %s, in front of everyone, with a ring made of straw. They said yes.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.night.betrothed.1: Somewhere in the song I proposed to %s. They said yes. It's real, and they're waiting for me.
I promised myself to %s, in front of everyone, with a ring made of straw. They said yes. They'll hold me to it.
Somewhere in the song I proposed to %s. They said yes. They'll hold me to it.
night.jaymoskingdoms.debt.beaten.0: No coin, no mercy. Count yourself lucky I leave you teeth.
night.jaymoskingdoms.debt.beaten.1: You were warned! You'll walk with a limp for a while.
night.jaymoskingdoms.debt.short.0: Short? Then the rest costs more. I'll be back tomorrow.
night.jaymoskingdoms.debt.short.1: That's not what you owe. It'll cost you extra to make up.
table.jaymoskingdoms.title: The table
table.jaymoskingdoms.sit: You sit down. Set the stake, then throw or deal.
table.jaymoskingdoms.rolled: The dice clatter across the board.
table.jaymoskingdoms.tie: A tie: the pot is split, %s each.
table.jaymoskingdoms.nobody: No hand stood: the stakes come back.
table.jaymoskingdoms.again: Set your stake and play again.
table.jaymoskingdoms.caught_note: %s was caught cheating and loses the stake.
table.jaymoskingdoms.caught.1: Marked cards, is it? Get out!
chalk.jaymoskingdoms.title: Chalk a sign
chalk.jaymoskingdoms.unlettered: You know none of the signs: you can only scrawl.
chalk.jaymoskingdoms.meaning.safe: A safe house: they will take you in here.
chalk.jaymoskingdoms.meaning.dog: A dog inside: it will give you away.
chalk.jaymoskingdoms.meaning.rich: Rich and careless: a good mark.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.passed.0: Your papers are in order. Go on through.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.passed.1: Hm. Everything is stamped. Carry on.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.spotted.0: This is forged! Stop right there!
papers.jaymoskingdoms.spotted.1: The seal is wrong. You're under arrest for forgery!
papers.jaymoskingdoms.pardon_held.0: A pardon, signed and sealed. Very well, you are free to go.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.pardon_held.1: The seal is good. The charge is dropped.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.pardon_spotted.0: This pardon is a fake! That makes it worse.
papers.jaymoskingdoms.pardon_spotted.1: Forged! You'll answer for this too.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.start.craft: Learn their trade (%s lessons, %s emeralds each)
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.start.fight: Learn to fight (%s lessons, %s emeralds each)
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.tomorrow: That's enough for one day. Come back tomorrow.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.taught.0: Good. Lesson %s of %s done. Come back tomorrow.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.taught.1: Again tomorrow. That was lesson %s of %s.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.taught.2: Not bad. %s of %s. Don't miss a day.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.finished.1: That's all I can teach of %s. You're no apprentice now.
lessons.jaymoskingdoms.finished.2: You've learned %s from me. Don't get yourself killed.
research.jaymoskingdoms.sage: The sage will look it up with you for a day. What do you want to know?
research.jaymoskingdoms.library: The shelves hold what is known. What will you look up?
research.jaymoskingdoms.stay: Stay near and unhurt while you read.
research.jaymoskingdoms.lost: You lost your place, and the study is gone.
research.jaymoskingdoms.tired: You've done your reading for the day. Come back tomorrow.
research.jaymoskingdoms.no_one: There is no one here to keep the books.
research.jaymoskingdoms.fears.stars: You learn how to face the %s better: %s stars.
research.jaymoskingdoms.fears.learned: You learn what the %s dreads: %s. Knowledge of it now stands at %s stars.
